task_description: The agents need to collaborate to analyze market data, make optimal trading decisions, execute trades, and verify the transactions to ensure consistency in position tracking.
expected_outcome: All agents should process accurate and timely market data, make correct trading decisions based on this data, execute orders at the right times, and maintain consistent position tracking.

agents.description: This agent is responsible for fetching the latest market data and analyzing trends to provide insights for trading decisions.
This agent evaluates the insights from the Market Analyzer and makes trading decisions based on predefined strategies.
This agent executes trade orders and verifies transactions to ensure they align with the intended trading strategy.
